instruction: Keep theme CSS scoping airtight: every selector (including html/body, :root, and at-rule bodies) must be prefixed into the .fq-theme-scope sandbox so theme CSS cannot restyle the host storefront. title: Theme CSS scoping and custom-code suite stays green
